final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.order_count) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(tc.order_count - overall.avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.order_count > overall.avg_count
